summary: Waterlogging in Line Par and Buddhi Vihar, roads dug up and left unrepaired, choked drains, city jams and missing medicines at the district hospital dominate complaints, while a Buddhi Vihar museum and park, a Civil Lines hospital foundation and MDA parks and a library are the main gains.

positives.english: A 100-bed government hospital has started being built in Civil Lines
positives.hindi: सिविल लाइंस में 100 बेड का सरकारी अस्पताल बनने लगा है
positives.basis: Royal Bulletin (23 Feb 2026): bhoomi pujan and foundation stone for a 100-bed government medical care hospital in the Civil Lines area, with construction start; the article names the Nagar MLA Ritesh Gupta as performing it. No completion date. Civil Lines is listed under Moradabad Rural in the BJP mandal report (31 Dec 2024), so the locality may be split between the two seats; the Nagar MLA link supports AC 28.

positives.english: The Trishul Defence Museum in Buddhi Vihar has opened, which is a good thing
positives.hindi: बुद्धि विहार का त्रिशूल रक्षा संग्रहालय खुल गया, अच्छी बात है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (27 Sep 2026): the Trishul Indian Defence Museum and Shri Ram Vatika in Buddhi Vihar were inaugurated in June 2026, with Bharatiya Khel Park and other projects dedicated on the same occasion. The article does not name the seat. Buddhi Vihar is named inside the Moradabad Nagar seat section of Amar Ujala's 20 Apr 2024 report (location evidence only; no electoral content used).

positives.english: The constitution-literature park in Buddhi Vihar is built
positives.hindi: बुद्धि विहार में संविधान-साहित्य पार्क बनकर तैयार हो गया
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (26 Jun 2025): constitution-literature park in Buddhi Vihar built at a cost of Rs 15 crore; Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla was chief guest at the event held on Wednesday (25 Jun 2025). The article does not name the seat; Buddhi Vihar is named inside Moradabad Nagar as in item 2.

positives.english: MDA parks like Bhimrao Ambedkar and Eco Herbal are complete
positives.hindi: भीमराव अंबेडकर पार्क और इको हर्बल पार्क बनकर तैयार हैं
positives.basis: MDA project page lists Bhimrao Ambedkar Park (Ashiyana) and Eco Herbal Park (Sector 9), Moradabad, both with status Completed. Official district-level MDA page, undated, no completion dates. AC membership unconfirmed.

positives.english: The MDA Jigyasa library is built and ready
positives.hindi: एमडीए की जिज्ञासा लाइब्रेरी बनकर तैयार है
positives.basis: MDA project page lists MDA Library Jigyasa (New Moradabad) with status Completed. Official district-level MDA page, undated. AC membership unconfirmed.

negatives.english: Rain fills Line Par with water and makes it hard to step out
negatives.hindi: बारिश होते ही लाइनपार में पानी भर जाता है, घर से निकलना मुश्किल
negatives.basis: Royal Bulletin (27 Sep 2026): after about 30 hours of rain, waterlogging in Line Par, Budh Bazar and Ramganga Vihar; the article says Line Par is a persistent problem that makes it hard for residents to leave home; Nagar Nigam teams are draining with machines. Patrika (5 Aug 2025): after 93.4 mm of rain in 15 hours, water reached homes in Line Par mohallas; the article blames failed Awas Vikas drainage in Buddhi Vihar. AC membership: Line Par is a Nagar mandal in the BJP mandal report (Amrit Vichar, 31 Dec 2024), and Amar Ujala (20 Apr 2024) names Line Par within the Moradabad Nagar seat (location evidence only).

negatives.english: Roads in Buddhi Vihar dug for pipelines are still broken
negatives.hindi: बुद्धि विहार में पाइपलाइन के लिए खुदी सड़कें अभी तक उखड़ी पड़ी हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (15 Sep 2026): roads dug up by the Jal Nigam team for pipelines left unrepaired in several places, from Sector 4 to Sector 9; Sector 9B road left incomplete for four months; Awas Vikas and Nagar Nigam have not fixed responsibility for repair. Amar Ujala (17 Sep 2026) repeats that roads from Sector 4 to 9 are still dug up. AC membership: Buddhi Vihar is named inside the Moradabad Nagar seat section of Amar Ujala (20 Apr 2024), location evidence only.

negatives.english: In Sitapuri Das Sarai the dirty drain is choked, and 5,000 people are troubled
negatives.hindi: सीतापुरी दस सराय में गंदा नाला जाम है, पांच हजार लोग परेशान हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (7 Jun 2026): drain between Sitapuri Das Sarai and Chau ki Basti choked; the article says 5,000 people of three settlements suffer; residents say the Nagar Nigam made no drainage plan despite a CM portal complaint. AC membership: Das Sarai is named as a Nagar mandal in the BJP mandal report (Amrit Vichar, 31 Dec 2024); the drain article itself does not name the seat, so this is mandal-level evidence.

negatives.english: Some medicines prescribed by the doctor are not available at the district hospital
negatives.hindi: जिला अस्पताल में डॉक्टर की लिखी कुछ दवाएं नहीं मिलतीं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (24 Dec 2025): at the district hospital, cough syrup, a pain tablet, diclofenac gel, a piles medicine and some eye drops were not available to patients. District-level hospital report, not specific to this AC.

negatives.english: Jams are common in the city, with heavy vehicle pressure all day
negatives.hindi: शहर में जाम आम बात है, दिनभर गाड़ियों का भारी दबाव रहता है
negatives.basis: Royal Bulletin (6 Oct 2026): the new SP Traffic says reducing city jams is the focus; places where vehicle pressure stays high through the day and jams recur are being identified. This is an official statement, no roads named. City-level, not a named AC location.

round2.changes: Fetched every cited URL and corrected claims the pages did not support: removed 'worst hit' (Patrika), 'only a visit' and 'patients told to buy outside' and 'full prescribed medicine not available' (Amar Ujala), and the 'residents' difficulties have grown' wording. Removed the MDA 24m Sector 15 road positive (page says Completed but its description says the road is being constructed) and the city-flooding negative (Amar Ujala 18 Aug 2026, not AC-specific). Added Amar Ujala 27 Sep 2026 (Buddhi Vihar museum and Shri Ram Vatika opened June 2026), Amar Ujala 15 and 17 Sep 2026 (Buddhi Vihar dug-up roads, new negative 2), and Amar Ujala 20 Apr 2024 as location evidence that names Line Par, Buddhi Vihar and Budh Bazar inside the Moradabad Nagar seat. Hospital item now cites the Nagar MLA named in the Royal Bulletin report. Negatives reordered: waterlogging, Buddhi Vihar roads, Das Sarai drain, district hospital medicines, city jams.

notes: AC identity: Wikipedia constituency list (fetched) gives No. 28 Moradabad Nagar, reserved None, Moradabad district, Moradabad Lok Sabha seat; AC 27 is Moradabad Rural. Region Rohilkhand is my assignment. Could not fetch the 2008 Delimitation Order PDF on India Code (connection reset and 503 on repeated tries), so the official ward/mohalla extent is still unconfirmed. Wikipedia AC pages and the Moradabad Municipal Corporation page give no ward-to-seat mapping; searches for a ward list found none. AC membership therefore rests on (a) the BJP mandal report (Amrit Vichar, 31 Dec 2024), which names Nagar mandals Chandra Nagar, Lainpar, Das Sarai, Katghar, Madhya Nagar and Rural mandals Civil Lines, Ramganga Vihar, Diwan Ka Bazar, Sehal, Bhojpur, and (b) Amar Ujala 20 Apr 2024, which places Line Par, Buddhi Vihar, Ramganga Vihar and Budh Bazar in the Moradabad Nagar seat section. That report is an election story; only its location sentences are used. Conflicts to check in the field: Ramganga Vihar is a Rural mandal in the mandal report but named inside Nagar in the 2024 report, so it is not used as an AC-specific place; Civil Lines may be split between AC 27 and AC 28. Weakest AC-specific negative is Das Sarai (mandal-level only); if that is not accepted, ac_specific_negatives falls to 2. Positives remain weaker than negatives: most are MDA district-level items (undated page, AC membership unconfirmed). Budh Bazar is only in the 2024 locality list and not separately sourced. Royal Bulletin 2026 items are dated; Patrika date taken from the article text (5 Aug 2025), its page header shows a different date. The district medicines item and city jams item are not AC-specific. Voice pass (Round 3): P1 reworded to 'construction has started' (foundation laid, basis); P2 to 'opened' with appreciation wording; N3 and N5 made spoken, N5 now says vehicle pressure as in the basis (not crowds). P3 to P5, N1, N2, N4 unchanged in wording.
